requested_outcome: Every generic world URL using sort=nearest resolves directly to its approved semantic near-me page, and every nearby entry generates the canonical page instead of a parameter-only URL.
natural_destination: VII vacation, spa, events, hourly, attractions, trails and providers search routes in Hebrew, English, French and Russian.
authorization_boundary: Local source repair and verification only. Publication is not authorized by the current request.

lesson_bundle.reason: A helper change is insufficient unless the actual route family and redirects are verified.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require canonical URL, preserved transactional parameters and direct permanent redirect evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Nearby behavior is a shared seven-world family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Apply and test one consistent rule across every supported world and locale.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a routing correction, not a search redesign.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve filters, dates, guests, language, location permission behavior and unrelated sorting.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Hourly is fixed but another world still opens a sort=nearest parameter URL.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one canonical world map at both server entry and shared client nearby state.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All seven generic routes and three locale prefixes resolve to their matching /near-me route.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The redirect loses dates, guests, filters or language.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove only the redundant nearest sort parameter and retain every other query value and locale.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Parameterized positive tests preserve all non-sort values byte-for-byte after URL decoding.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Selecting another sort is redirected incorrectly.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Activate canonicalization only when sort equals nearest.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Recommended, price and rating URLs return no nearby redirect.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Old managed popular-search data still emits the legacy parameter URL.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Normalize server-provided initial presentation data as well as asynchronously loaded data.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A legacy managed nearby item renders one canonical semantic destination without duplication.

affected_family: he, en, fr and ru locale prefixes
shared nearby sort hook, search box and managed popular-search links

sources.label: Previously qualified seven-world nearby route family

midpoint_gate.trigger: The pure canonicalization helper and proxy contract pass for hourly plus one localized route.

attack_questions: Can any supported generic world still retain sort=nearest after navigation?
Can a locale prefix or transactional filter be lost?
Can a non-nearest sorting choice be redirected?
Can a canonical near-me page enter a redirect loop?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact local built-candidate HTTP and browser checks for the reported hourly URL and representative desktop/mobile canonical pages.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated matrix for seven worlds, four locales, preserved parameters, negative sorts and loop prevention.

effectiveness.baseline: The reported public hourly URL remains /hourly?sort=nearest instead of the approved semantic page.
effectiveness.target: Zero supported generic nearest URLs remain after one redirect, with no lost query state and no redirect loops.
